prompt: I need to composite two images together. Take the ocean hex tile and overlay it on top of a green (#2d5a1e) background canvas that's 200x200 pixels, centered. The hex tile should keep its transparency so you can see the green background through the corners.

assertions.text: Output image exists and is 200x200 pixels
Corner pixels are green (#2d5a1e) not white or transparent
Center pixel contains ocean tile content (not pure green)
Hex edges show clean transition between ocean content and green background
No white background artifacts from the source hex tile
